cases.title: Initiate drag event and capture product title and price
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable='true' and data-testid='product-item-1') initiates a drag event and successfully captures the product's title (from data-testid='product-title-1') and price (from data-testid='product-price-1') for transfer.

cases.title: Drag and Drop Product Item into Drop Area
cases.description: Verify that a user can drag and drop a product item (e.g., data-testid='product-item-1') into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') to add it to the cart.

cases.title: Cart Display Automatic Update on Drop
cases.description: Verify that upon dropping a product item into the drop area, the cart display automatically updates such that the product title appears in .box2, the unit price appears in .box3, and the quantity appears in .box1.

cases.title: Support for Adding Different and Repeated Products
cases.description: Verify that the system supports adding both different products and repeated products into the cart via drag and drop.

cases.title: Calculate and display total price in allMoney element
cases.description: Verify that the system calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays it in the <div id="allMoney"> element.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and their explicit scenarios are adequately covered by the proposed test cases. No blockers or missing scenarios were found.
All requirements have been fully and accurately covered by the test cases. No blockers, coverage gaps, or redundancies were found.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1 describes initiating a drag event on a draggable product list item and capturing its title and price; it contains multiple distinct behaviors (initiating drag, capturing title, capturing price) with a normal test scenario. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3 describes allowing users to drag and drop product items into a designated drop area to add them to the cart, updating the cart display (.box1 for quantity, .box2 for title, .box3 for unit price), and supporting both different and repeated products; it contains multiple distinct behaviors (drop action, cart display update for title, price, quantity, support for repeated products) with normal test scenarios. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5 describes calculating the total price by summing all product prices, formatting to two decimal places with a currency symbol, and displaying it in the <div id="allMoney"> element; it contains multiple distinct behaviors (summing prices, formatting to two decimal places with currency symbol, displaying in designated element) with a normal test scenario.
